move: five columns of stacked chevrons stream downward, centre column fastest
how: An SVG holds five columns of rounded-stroke polyline chevrons pointing down, cycling orange, white and amber, with the centre column widest and most opaque and the outer ones smaller and dimmer. Each column group translates y by pitch times speed (3, 4, 5, 4, 3 pitches) over D with ease none, so the centre streams fastest and every column tiles seamlessly. The whole SVG sways x from -14 to 14px and back with one sine.inOut yoyo cycle, and a vertical fade masks the top and bottom 22% into the near-black background.
adapt: Change the three stroke colours and background, the column widths and stroke weights, or the number of columns. Keep integer pitches per D for each column so the stream loops; D is 10s here although the catalog lists 15.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the SVG, builds the column groups of polylines and adds the fade overlay; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with one linear y tween per column over D plus the SVG sway. Column centres are absolute 1280-wide coordinates; scale them to the shot width.
caveats: duration is 10s, not the 15s listed in the catalog
